_readme: Template for the launcher's tool list. It is copied to your per-user
config directory the first time the launcher starts, and the copy is the
file the application reads and writes. This template is never written to.
Set moonraker_host to your printer's hostname or IP address, either by
editing the copy or through Manage printers / tools in the application.
The Moonraker query URL is derived from moonraker_host and
moonraker_api_port, so there is no separate URL to keep in step.
